posts.body: We'll be moving to Tai Tam beginning of August. My oldest (4yo) will go to school but I was wondering whether there are any (multiples) playgroups on the South Side. My b/g twins are almost 19 months old (20 months by the time we arrive).
posts.body_with_quotes: We'll be moving to Tai Tam beginning of August. My oldest (4yo) will go to school but I was wondering whether there are any (multiples) playgroups on the South Side. My b/g twins are almost 19 months old (20 months by the time we arrive).

posts.body:
Hi Sofie! I know you from twinstuff.com 

There is a local Mothers of Multiples group and they organise playgroups twice a month - it resumes again in September (since so many people go away for July & August). 

Sounds like our twins are nearly the same age - mine will be 21 months in August (gg)

http://moms-hongkong.com/

Look forward to meeting you in person! 

ANd back to your question, yeah there are plenty of twins living in the South side :flower:

Hi C!

Yes, I remember. Mine were born end of November, yours end of October. Haven't seen you around much on Twinstuff! I plan on signing up for the MOMS as soon as I get there. I was hoping there may be some other "sets" in the Tai Tam area ... I am sure I'll find out though. 

Thanks!

Franca

posts.body:
Hello,

I have a toddler and twin babies. I am originally from HK but my husband is an Aussie. When we visited my relos in HK this Feb, we were centre of attentions everywhere we went becasue of our twin babies. We will be visiting HK again for 3 months Jan next year. So it is good to know that there are local playgroups for mutiples in HK.

:flower:
